This can be a slight breaking change since previously the `refine` didn't look like this, but like [this](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/src/widgets/toggle-refinement/toggle-refinement.js#L40:L40).
I do prefer this change of wrapping isRefined in an object consistently.
However it can be a breaking change to those who create custom components using the connector.
What do you think?

Oh, no. it's not a breaking change. Custom components will use the connector, not the widget or the component file. So it's only internal change 👍🏻
I'm not super familiar with this but isn't we supposed to pass the `attribute:{{value}}`  here ?
let's not change it in this PR :)
